title: Migrate metadata-server's 40 inline unit tests to tests/ integration suite; remove MockBackend test_support module
description:
Implement option (i) from bd:JMAP-826m.14's ratified recommendation (no human pushback in ~46 hours): drop the inline test_support::MockBackend module from crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/lib.rs (lines 144-477, ~350 LoC) and migrate the 40 inline #[tokio::test] functions in crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/metadata.rs (lines 906-2164, ~1250 LoC) to crate-jmap-metadata-server/tests/metadata_tests.rs using the public MemoryBackend.

Per workspace AGENTS.md '>3 files = file an epic, get approval': this work touches src/lib.rs, src/metadata.rs, and tests/metadata_tests.rs at minimum. The recommendation has been ratified per the 24-hour rule on .14, but the actual implementation needs human authorization for the scope.

# Scope and rationale

- mail-server (canonical extension-server template) has ZERO inline #[cfg(test)] unit tests in src/*.rs. Only integration tests in tests/. metadata-server diverges by carrying ~350 lines of MockBackend infrastructure AND 40 inline async unit tests AND parallel integration tests — three test surfaces where the canonical has one.
- Every JmapBackend/MetadataBackend trait method addition (e.g. JmapBackend::principal_id at JMAP-ga0q.1, MetadataBackend's unsupported_object_type guard at JMAP-826m.13) must land in BOTH MemoryBackend AND MockBackend, doubling maintenance.
- MockBackend's get_objects uses a serde_json::to_value + from_value round-trip to convert Metadata to a generic O. This 'serde-round-trip downcast' is subtle and the inline tests rely on it. Contributor confusion risk.
- MockBackend's get_changes is a simplified 'all-or-nothing' that returns all recorded changes if since_state != current. It does NOT exercise the real RFC 8620 §5.2 dedup. Inline tests that pre-populate the change log essentially bypass the dedup algorithm.

# Suggested decomposition into child beads

- .1 Inventory the 40 inline tests by category: filter-validator unit tests, destroy validate-and-collect tests, /set boilerplate tests, /changes args-parsing tests, etc. Identify any tests that DEPEND on MockBackend's idiosyncrasies (force_create_error injection, get_changes all-or-nothing) and may need oracle adjustment when migrated to MemoryBackend.
- .2 Migrate batch 1 (e.g. the 6-7 tests added under JMAP-826m.1 + the 7 tests added under JMAP-826m.34). These were the most recently added and have the least migration risk.
- .3-.7 Migrate remaining batches in groups of ~7-8 tests each.
- .8 Delete the test_support module from src/lib.rs and confirm metadata.rs has no remaining inline tests. cargo fmt + clippy + test workspace.
- .9 Close JMAP-826m.14 as superseded by this epic.

# Test discipline

Each migrated test MUST preserve its independent oracle (RFC/draft text quote, not the code under test). Where a test depended on MockBackend's force_create_error injection, the migration MUST find an equivalent MemoryBackend-native way to trigger the same SetError (e.g. seed a uniqueness conflict to trigger alreadyExists, register an unknown account-mismatch to trigger SetError::Other, etc.). If a test cannot be expressed against MemoryBackend without weakening the oracle, file a sub-bead asking whether to keep that specific test inline (option (ii) escape hatch) or accept the coverage loss.

# Out of scope

- Propagating this refactor to other extension-server siblings — siblings that DO have inline unit tests should not adopt the same pattern, but each crate has its own audit cost and that audit is a separate question.
- Restructuring the public MetadataBackend trait. The migration is test-only.

Authorization needed for: source-file deletions and large-scale test relocations.
